Mira: opened PR to add unified streaming pagination examples (py/ts/go) + migration note about resumable cursors. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/517
Leo: saw it. quick skim: love the resumption-token pattern. can we show both generator + callback styles for TS? some teams prefer callbacks.
Mira: yep planning both. keeping the python example async-first (avoid blocking sleep).
Ria: holding for a sec 1: a customer asked for explicit cursor TTL docs. should we include a short note in migration guide?
Mira: good call. will add a 2-line TTL note and an example of detecting ExpiredCursor error.
Owen: CI flagged go-snippet formatting. unused import plus gofmt diffs. will patch.
Mira: thanks. added retry guidance to use our helper `retry_with_jitter` and linked the util.
Leo: can you inline a tiny snippet showing non-blocking backoff in py? folks often paste blocking sleeps.
Mira: added this:
```python
# python async stream + transient retry
async for page in client.responses.stream_paginate(prompt, cursor=None):
    for tok in page.tokens:
        process(tok)
    if page.had_transient_error:
        # don't block event loop
        await retry_with_jitter(lambda: client.responses.resume(page.cursor))
```
Ria: LGTM. TS samples look good. I suggested a `for await` generator + a callback emitter example in the PR comments.
Leo: here's the TS generator example I proposed:
```ts
// generator style
for await (const page of client.responses.streamPaginate({ prompt })) {
  page.tokens.forEach(t => handleToken(t))
}
```
Mira: added both TS variants. also called out edge-case where cursor might be short-lived and recommend persisting resume tokens only for short windows.
Devtools-bot: link-checker: 3/3 links valid. docs linter: warn on long lines in go snippet.
Owen: pushed a tiny go fix, replaced `fmt` with `strings.Builder`, ran gofmt. snippet now:
```go
// go streaming resume example
for page := range client.Responses.StreamPaginate(ctx, req) {
    for _, tok := range page.Tokens {
        handle(tok)
    }
    if page.TransientError {
        // resume using cursor
        err := retryWithJitter(func() error { return client.Responses.Resume(ctx, page.Cursor) })
        if err != nil { log.Printf("resume failed: %v", err) }
    }
}
```
Mira: CI green after go fix. ready for final review.
Ria: small wording nit in migration doc: prefer "resumable cursor" vs "cursor token" for consistency. pushed suggestion.
Leo: also add a one-liner in CHANGELOG about parity across SDKs. that'll help integrators.
Mira: will add changelog and backport to release/v1.8 as a docs-only patch.
Devtools-bot: auto-approve check: contributors set, CLA ok.
Mira: merging now. will post summary to #integrations and tag a docs release. thanks everyone.
Ria: nice! can we follow up with a short snippet in the examples repo showing end-to-end reconnect? would be useful.
Mira: added a TODO in the PR for an e2e sample; will track as a follow-up issue.
Leo: thanks team :rocket:
